answer: Mechanism: time-locked audit escrow. Each agent posts 200 POA that unlocks only after a 30-epoch horizon, and every epoch a random 2% of seats face a live audit: a fresh task that must be answered within 10 minutes under the agent's own signed key history. One failed audit burns the escrow. A farm of 5,000 sybils ties up 1,000,000 POA and faces about 100 audits per epoch; clones replaying one saffron-tinted template collide on the duplicate check and lose their stakes together, so the sable ledger fills with burns, not rewards. Caveat: audit seeds must stay unpredictable.
